name: my-team
description: atmux team — edit this to match your project
_comment_singleSession: Default false (2026-04-30 reversal of ADR-026) — cage isolation per ADR-018 is the safe path; singleSession opts out of it on the daily-driver socket and reintroduces the side-channel pollution class (cage-prefix leak, cross-socket spawn, partial-rename mess). Launcher sessions (atmux_<team> created by atmux doctor --fix) preserve the at-a-glance benefit while keeping isolation. Set true ONLY for non-human-driven teams or detached observer setups (declared escape hatch).
_comment_drivers: Drivers use isolated worktrees. Each pane starts in an interactive login zsh; when tui names a harness, atmux verifies the prompt and launches that harness as the shell's child through the pinned pane target.
_comment_bot: ADR-285: one cooperative _bot seat for persistent parent teams. It has an isolated .atmux/worktrees/bot worktree on <base>-bot and sits after drivers, before members. null tui starts zsh for operator use and is deliberately unroutable by _superbot; choose an explicit harness + account in the durable team config before automated offers are enabled. Nested teams omit this block unless configured explicitly.

tuiCommands._comment: Per-team TUI launch aliases. If set, the prefix here replaces the built-in default for that TUI type. atmux appends --model <model> unless the prefix already has one. Example: "claude": "claude --plugin-dir=$HOME/work/journals/.sb/claude-skills"

_comment_claudeAccount: Per-member Claude config-dir isolation. Valid values: 'default' (host default — Claude reads its standard config dir), 'personal', 'icloud', 'ifca', 'unum', OR any custom suffix the operator maintains. When set + != 'default', spawn prefixes 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<HOME>/.claude-<value>' so the member's nested-shell `claude` invocations inherit an account-isolated config tree (no OAuth cross-pollination, no fresh-spawn re-auth dance). Per ADR-024 spawn-account-matching + ADR-094 c-alias spawn convention. Field lives at the MEMBER level (per-member override); template's lead carries an example string below.
_comment_members: ADR-239 §A2 (amended 2026-05-26): strict 5-name member roster across every parent team — keep only members named {lead, planner, docs, reviewer, gitter}. Specialist seats (ombudsman, unblocker, discorder, devops, dba, tester, fe-auth, be-auth, db-auth, etc.) were swept out in the 2026-05-26 trim. Operator may re-add seats per-team but the template ships the lean default.
_comment_discord: Optional. webhook = pings target (env ATMUX_DISCORD_WEBHOOK overrides). color = hex override for embed (auto-derived from team-name hash if absent, see ADR-019 §16-color palette). emoji = leading title glyph (defaults to 🤖). Strip any field to fall back to defaults.
